result.title: Component Pooling Trained Across Orientations for Few-Shot Remote Sensing Scene Classification
result.summary: Few-shot remote sensing scene classification (FSRSSC) aims to recognize novel scene categories from only a few labeled images. Most FSRSSC methods summarize the feature map of an image by global average pooling, which treats the few objects that define an aerial scene and the large background around them alike, and they rarely consider that aerial images have no canonical orientation. To address these issues, we propose RoCoP, a parameter-free component pooling network trained across orientations. RoCoP consists of a feature extractor, a non-negative decomposition module (NDM) and a component scoring module (CSM). NDM factorizes the local descriptors of each image into a few additive components with a deterministic initialization and a single multiplicative update, so that the positions of one object are grouped together. CSM weights each component by its activation magnitude and converts the weights into a soft mask for pooling. Because both modules are invariant to permutations of feature positions, the only rotation-sensitive part of the pipeline is the backbone, which we train to classify randomly rotated views of every image. Experiments on NWPU-RESISC45, AID and UC Merced show that component pooling and rotated-view training are complementary: together they improve a strong transfer-learning baseline by about 2.5 points in 5-way 1-shot accuracy on NWPU-RESISC45 and AID, without adding parameters at inference. Under an identical protocol, RoCoP outperforms re-implemented metric-based and task-adaptive methods, and NDM and CSM also improve existing methods when plugged into them. We further identify the regime in which the method does not apply, namely very small base sets.

AI.brief_summary: 论文针对少样本遥感场景分类提出 RoCoP：用非负分解把局部描述子归并为少量加性组件，再按激活强度加权生成软掩码池化，并对随机旋转视图训练骨干，以替代全局平均池化且不增加推理参数。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“少量组件+软掩码”压缩特征图、突出定义性对象的做法，可为 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与细节保真提供可核查线索，但其不涉及 latent 推理状态生成，联系主要在表示侧。
